summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd., an Israeli medical-device firm, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 31, 2026, announcing completion of patient enrollment (48 patients) in its multicenter IMPACT pilot study of Alpha DaRT for unresectable pancreatic cancer. The filing is a routine operational update regarding a clinical trial, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No financial terms, prices, premiums, or advisor details are mentioned. The release describes trial expansion from 12 to 48 patients and targets initial data in early 2027 to inform a pivotal study design. There is no transaction, capital action, or governance event; the filing simply reports clinical progress and enrollment milestone.
